stem: Which goal was Garrison seeking to accomplish through this publication?
visual_elements: I will be as harsh as truth, and as uncompromising as justice. On this subject I do not wish to think, or speak, or write, with moderation. No! no! . . . I am in earnest—I will not [lie]—I will not excuse—I will not retreat a single inch—AND I WILL BE HEARD. —William Lloyd Garrison, The Liberator, January 1, 1831
